blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Sultan Kudarat Rep. Arnulfo Go on Thursday pleaded not guilty to a graft charge in connection with the alleged misuse of his Priority Development Assistance Fund (PDAF). Go personally entered his plea during his arraignment before the Sandiganbayan Sixth Division. READ: Ex-Sultan Kudarat solon facing malversation raps yields in GenSan Associate
